title: Kids Tree Canopy Adventure
description: Children's play area among the trees at the top of Grouse Mountain: treehouses joined by net bridges, a tube slide down the slope, a vertical climbing net and a wooden footbridge. The sign says it is for ages 3 and up and adult supervision is required. Outside the City of Vancouver (District of North Vancouver) and inside the paid area of the Grouse Mountain resort (reached by the Skyride), so it is an exception to the rule of recording only playgrounds open to everyone. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken.
location: Grouse Mountain, District of North Vancouver, BC
source: Own survey
rights: CC BY 4.0
image_alt_text: Treehouse tower with a green tube slide running down the slope, and a net bridge on the right, Kids Tree Canopy Adventure, Grouse Mountain.
description_ja: Grouse Mountain の山頂の、木々の間の子どもの遊び場。網の橋でつながったツリーハウス、斜面へ下りる筒形のすべり台、縦に登る網、木の橋がある。看板によれば 3 歳以上が対象で、大人の付き添いが要る。バンクーバー市の外（ノースバンクーバー郡）で、Grouse Mountain のリゾートの有料の区域（Skyride で上がる）の中にある。誰でも入れる遊び場だけを記録する決まりの例外として載せた。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。
